$schema_note: Number Sky design tokens, direction B 'Star Lines'. Same shape as tokens.v1.json; keys v1 had keep their names where the meaning is unchanged, new keys are marked NEW in their role. Claude Code: read colours, type, radius, space and size only from this file. Light is the default theme; dark is designed, not inverted.

grid.role: NEW. Dot-grid pattern on the page background (decorative only, 1.2px dots every 18-20px)

surface.role: cards, buttons, plates' surround, label backgrounds over map tracks

surface-2.role: insets, trays, plates, chips, locked stations

hover.role: NEW. Hover fill for secondary and ghost buttons (pointer devices only)

ink.role: primary text, card borders, number-line axis, lit track, lit station ring

ink-soft.role: secondary text, plate labels, locked labels

line.role: decorative dividers only; carries no meaning

line-strong.role: NEW. Borders of controls that must be seen (3:1+), unlit dashed track, dashed tray

sky.role: counters (given), dot arrays, bar-model whole. Focus ring moved to 'focus'

counter-2.role: NEW. Second counter colour: added counters, second group in an array split. Always paired with the ring shape

accent.role: primary action, current station ('Now'), selected state, current session part (learner can swap via accentThemes)

accent-soft.role: number-sentence strip, selected tint, hint panel

accent-text.role: NEW. Accent as text or thin line on surface and bg: unknown slot '?', links

focus.role: NEW. Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 2-3px offset

star.role: NEW. Lit and almost-lit star fill, gem fill. Always drawn with a star-ink outline

star-ink.role: NEW. Outline of star and gem shapes

item.role: NEW. Every countable story item (tickets, coins, pucks...): one hue for all items

item-detail.role: NEW. Cut-outs and details inside items

good.role: correct state border, icon and text

warm.role: not-yet state border, icon and text (warm clay, never red)

blk.role: base-ten block fill (unchanged from v1 so blocks look the same to her)

blk-line.role: base-ten block edges and unit grid

accentThemeRule: Accent themes avoid the hues that already mean something: green (correct), clay (not yet), yellow (lit star, gem) and violet (items). v1's Lime, Coral and Lavender themes are retired for that reason; a saved v1 theme maps to Cobalt.

display.use: headings, line badges, eyebrows: words only. Any heading that contains a numeral or operator (for example '× 3 and 4') is set in the body face

body.use: all running text, all numerals and maths, buttons, options, keypad

type.prompt: clamp(19px, 1.9vw, 24px) / 1.4, 400, body; numbers in the prompt 700
type.label: 15px / 1.3, 700, body

border.heroCard: 2px solid ink (today card, question card, map card)
border.control: 1.5px solid ink (secondary buttons, chips with borders)

space.columnGap: 24px (home columns, question and feedback side by side)
space.asideGap: 28px between practice work area and help aside

size.breakpoints: compact under 720px (single column, help row at the bottom); regular 720-1023px; wide from 1024px (two columns). Design target 1280 x 800; minimum 360px wide
size.contentMaxWidth: home 1184px; practice and feedback 1120px; grown-up view 1040px

elevation.card: none. Cards are separated by borders, not shadows
elevation.dialog: 2px ink border on surface over the scrim

motion.deal: 260ms cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1): item travels from tray to plate on a shallow arc
motion.jump: 420ms ease-in-out per jump: arc draws, then the marker moves along it
motion.stripReveal: 160ms fade: the answer slot fills in
motion.stationLight: 320ms: station fill changes, then a 1.0-1.12-1.0 scale on the star
motion.trackFill: 600ms ease-out: the track segment to the newly lit station draws from left to right
motion.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion or the app setting: all transitions 0ms, end states shown immediately, nothing depends on movement

baseTen.note: drawn on a 10-unit grid with non-scaling strokes; one hue (blk) for all three; size and shape carry the value

array.split: 6px gap between strategy groups; second group uses counter-2 rings
array.crossedOut: hollow dot with a diagonal stroke

numberLine.labels: live HTML text centred under ticks, 15px body
numberLine.jumpArc: quadratic arc, height 28px for +10 and 16px for +1; labels above arcs, max 6 labelled jumps, further jumps grouped

wordProblem.slot: 56 x 44 rounded 10, 2px ink; unknown slot dashed accent-text
